approach:
This attempt fixes all three G1 refusals and rewrites feat.brd in full.

1. SM-5 no longer says 'the only change to an existing function'. It now names both additive changes exactly as feat.classification records them ('Two changes touch existing behaviour, and both are additive'): CR-4, the optional argument on build_explanation_request; and CR-1, feed ingestion accepting the optional paid_date, with the new reject reason 'paid_date' and the new field Invoice.paid_date. The section 4 intro now lists the same two changes and the four new functions, citing feat.classification. OS-6 reads 'Changes to existing behaviour beyond the two additive changes'.
2. The R-AP-12 row no longer says the outcome 'delivers' the roadmap item. It says feat.fitment gives R-AP-12 as the linked roadmap item, and that feat.fitment's agent judgement is that the entry matches it. BQ-5 was reworded to match.
3. The auditability row and the strategy row are now labelled 'agent judgement, recorded in feat.fitment', with the underlying source facts kept separate. My own uncited sentence 'Every rule in this BRD is explicit' was removed.

I then ran the verifier again and applied all 7 wording findings:
- The FIT-Y-ROADMAP caveat (FQ-5) was added.
- The REQ-03 approvals are now shown as the SIMULATED gate decisions recorded in COMMUNICATION.md.
- BQ-9 'must stay distinct' became feat.fitment's recommendation.
- The category is attributed to the REQ-02 classification.
- The question-set intro no longer says every question was answered.
- S-1 now reads 'each paid invoice'.
- 'Primary' user became 'the users named in the ticket'.
- The four repositories now cite the feat.intake Source table.

judge.notes:
I checked feat.brd.md statement by statement against feat.fitment, feat.intake, org.templates, org.strategy_capability and org.decision_log. I also checked it against the other files the agent read: feat.classification, feat.prebacklog, requirements/ZD-48600.md and COMMUNICATION.md.

All three refusal reasons from the previous attempt are fixed.
(1) SM-5 and section 4 now name both additive changes to existing behaviour: CR-4, the optional `risk` argument, and CR-1, the `paid_date` column, reject reason and field. This matches feat.classification lines 27-29.
(2) The roadmap link now says feat.fitment "judges the entry matches" R-AP-12, and labels this as agent judgement (section 2 and BQ-5). It no longer says "delivers".
(3) The auditability link is labelled as agent judgement recorded in feat.fitment. The facts behind it are kept separate and quoted correctly: "uses no LLM; it is a rule on the predicted delay", and the reject reason 'paid_date'.

Numbers and identifiers all appear in the cited sources:
- 30 and 10, the >30 / >10 thresholds, and "two decimals" are in feat.intake CR-3, CR-5 and CR-6.
- The buckets (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) are in org.strategy_capability.
- T2, R-AP-12, R-AP-14, Q4 2026, PROV-ACME-2026-11, acme-text-2/3 and 2026-12-01 are in feat.fitment.
- 2026-10-24 and feed v3 are in feat.intake.
- REG-LPR-2026-4.2 and "more than 60 days" are in feat.fitment.
- D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 are in org.decision_log.
- L-007 and L-011 are in memory.
- Node.js is in ZD-48600.md.
- The class names and columns (risk-high/medium/low/unknown; Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount) are in the ZD-48600.md design-library override.

The REQ-03 gate decisions ("PM: approve by sim.pm; Leadership: approve by sim.leadership") and the SIMULATED status match COMMUNICATION.md.

Derived statements are labelled as agent judgement:
- the boundaries in BR-5 and BR-7;
- OS-2, which says the risk label is advisory;
- finance teams as indirect users;
- B-A6, which says a call without `risk` builds today's prompt.

The owners of the open questions are carried over exactly as recorded. FQ-1 has PM / Leadership and classification OQ-1 has PM; the rest are marked "Not recorded".

The BRD covers all eight template sections and adds a business question set and a validation check. The decision-log check (no conflict) is accurate.

Completeness is scored 4 for two reasons:
- The workbook action "asks the business question set" was met only by answering the agent's own question set from the inputs. No stakeholder was asked; the document says so openly and flags that org.templates has no question set (OQ-B7).
- The BRD has no business KPI. This is correctly flagged as not met (OQ-B3), not invented.

Minor: section 4 cites "CR-7" next to the repository list, but CR-7 supports only the flow wording. The repository names come from the feat.intake Source table, which is also cited. I do not count this as unsupported.

The judge_attempt3.json file in the step folder seems to belong to a different version of the BRD: it refers to SKILL.md and a PM approvals row, neither of which is in this output. I did not rely on it.
